headline: WNBA Semifinals Game 2: Aces rebound behind Wilson masterclass to tie series 1-1
whyCareReason: A'ja Wilson powers Las Vegas to an 83-74 victory with 28 points and 13 boards, evening the series heading back to Nevada.
teaser: Aces tie series 1-1 with 83-74 road triumph in San Francisco. Semifinal moves to Las Vegas for Game 3.
story: The Las Vegas Aces reclaimed control of their playoff destiny on Wednesday night, holding off the Golden State Valkyries 83-74 in Game 2 at Chase Center to level their WNBA semifinal series 1-1. A'ja Wilson delivered a majestic performance with 28 points, 13 rebounds and 4 blocks, answering Sunday's frustration. Kelsey Plum added 20 points, while Golden State was led by Gabby Williams' 19 points. The series now shifts to Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas for Game 3 on Friday.
stakes: Series level 1-1 as Aces reclaim home-court advantage.
rivalryAngle: Two-time champions assert postseason pedigree in San Francisco.
